piecewise_affine_arms: For fixed integer split_count, each fixed combination of strict fallback, operand DAZ, and result FTZ masks is an affine scale or zero map in accumulator. With a subnormal reciprocal and either signed zero accumulator, strict multiplication skips its nonzero-operands fallback and flushes that reciprocal, so the selected local derivative in accumulator is zero. With a nonzero accumulator the strict fallback gives the reciprocal as the local derivative.
